annotations.title: Domino's® Kicks Off National Dairy Month With 50% Off Pizzas June 1-7
Pizza Delivery & Carryout, Pasta, Chicken & More | Domino's
Pizza Delivery & Carryout, Pasta, Chicken & More | Domino's
Get National & Local Dominos Pizza Coupons for Carryout or Delivery
Domino's Coupons & Promo Codes: Up To 50% Off – June 2026

content.text:
Here are the **current Domino’s U.S. deals/codes** I found:

- **50% off pizzas** — Domino’s announced a **50% off pizza deal for June 1–7, 2026**. Since today is **June 7, 2026**, this may be the last day to use it. ([ir.dominos.com](https://ir.dominos.com/node/24631/pdf?utm_source=openai))  
- **Mix & Match:** choose any 2+ items for **$6.99 each** — prices may be higher by location. ([dominos.com](https://www.dominos.com/?type=order_carryout&utm_source=openai))  
- **Carryout Deal:** **$7.99 each** for 1-topping pizzas or 8-piece wings — carryout only, location pricing may vary. ([dominos.com](https://www.dominos.com/?type=order_carryout&utm_source=openai))  
- **Perfect Combo:** **$19.99** for two medium 1-topping pizzas + two orders of 16-piece bread bites. ([dominos.com](https://www.dominos.com/pages/order/coupon?lang=en&utm_source=openai))  
- Third-party coupon sites list possible codes like **1126** and **9214** for **20% off**, but these can be location-specific and less reliable than Domino’s own coupon page. ([goodshop.com](https://www.goodshop.com/coupons/dominos.com?utm_source=openai))  

Best place to check: go to Domino’s **Coupons/Deals** page or app, enter your local store, then look under **Coupons**—Domino’s deals vary by franchise/location.
